headline: SL Green Realty Raises Full-Year Guidance as Manhattan Office Occupancy Reaches 95%
summary: SL Green Realty raised its full-year guidance as third-quarter portfolio occupancy reached 95%.
why: SL Green is Manhattan's largest office landlord, providing critical insight into commercial real estate leasing dynamics and return-to-office trends.

impacts.name: SL Green Realty Corp.
impacts.why: Strong occupancy rates and upgraded guidance signal resilient rental cash flows in prime commercial office real estate.
